reviewed_input: candidate-questions.json and independently opened official Mariinsky Theatre pages only. Writer articles, source dossiers, editorial keys, and local answer keys were not read before this freeze.

items.uniqueness: Clear: the official page identifies Pyotr Tchaikovsky as the composer; Modest Tchaikovsky is the librettist, so the similarly named distractor does not answer the music question.

sources_opened.title: Пиковая дама — Приморская сцена Мариинского театра
sources_opened.evidence: The official repertoire page identifies the music as Pyotr Tchaikovsky's and the libretto as Modest Tchaikovsky's after Pushkin.

items.uniqueness: Clear when the stem's original 1869 version is retained: the official account calls it Mussorgsky's first authorial version and separately identifies later Rimsky-Korsakov, Lamm, and Shostakovich versions or orchestrations.

sources_opened.title: Мариинский театр представляет премьеру «Бориса Годунова» в первой авторской редакции 1869 года
sources_opened.evidence: The official news item states that Mussorgsky proposed the first version in 1869 and distinguishes later versions and orchestrations.

items.uniqueness: Clear: the official exhibition says Rimsky-Korsakov completed the opera in March 1881 and describes it as his opera.

sources_opened.title: Снегурочка — выставка к 175-летию Н. А. Римского-Корсакова
sources_opened.evidence: The official exhibition identifies The Snow Maiden as Rimsky-Korsakov's opera and dates its completion to March 1881.

items.uniqueness: Clear if the wording remains 'leading composer': Borodin wrote and adapted the work but died before finishing it; Glazunov and Rimsky-Korsakov completed or orchestrated parts, so neither is its principal composer.

sources_opened.title: Только одно исполнение — опера «Князь Игорь» на Приморской сцене
sources_opened.evidence: The official Mariinsky page names Alexander Borodin, says he wrote the opera for nearly eighteen years but did not finish it, and distinguishes Glazunov's and Rimsky-Korsakov's subsequent contributions.

source_limits: This is a candidate-only blind phase. It establishes authorship and the key version/completion distinctions from one official primary institutional page per item; it does not review any writer claim, metadata, or private intended answer.
release_boundary: This is a private native fact-check record. It is neither external acceptance nor authorization to publish.
